title: Governance: SIRINX LINE Risk Gate + Auto-send Prevention

context.goal: Review and harden SIRINX LINE governance: deny-list patterns for forbidden claims (guaranteed ROI, zero downtime, no risk), human handoff detection keywords, commitment phrase patterns, auto-send/broadcast kill switches (env-gated), and GHOSTCLAW receipt writing. Ensure zero auto-send without human gate by default, and all human handoff requests write provenance receipts to ~/.ghostclaw/receipts/.
deliverables: DenyList with 14+ forbidden claim patterns covering Thai + English
Handoff keyword detection (price inquiry, negotiation, commitment)
Commitment pattern detection (sign contract, agree deal, delivery date)
RiskAssessment dataclass with is_risky, requires_human, requires_handoff flags
RiskGate class with env-gated auto_send and broadcast checks
GovernanceReceipt with receipt_id, chat_id, action, status, payload, reason, timestamp
Claim guard that prepends disclaimer text when risky patterns matched in bot replies

notes: Deny list must prevent: guaranteed savings, 30% reduction, zero downtime, no risk claims, free energy claims; Handoff keywords must include price negotiation patterns; All receipts follow existing ~/.ghostclaw/receipts/ convention
